description:
A spell school: the kind of damage a spell, an ability or a boss attack deals (architecture 9.1). Each school
is a vanilla damage type ``realmforge:<id>``, in ``#minecraft:bypasses_cooldown`` so its hits are never
swallowed by the hurt cooldown.

``physical`` damage meets armor (our formula) and can be dodged; ``magic`` damage bypasses armor, spell power
raises it and the school's resistance lowers it. ``power`` and ``resistance`` name secondary stats (shares in
``content/stats/``) that raise the school's damage dealt and lower its damage taken.

color.description: Colour of its spells: spell bar frames, the cast bar, damage numbers in tooltips, "#RRGGBB".
color.title: Color

combat_text_color.description: Colour of its floating combat text, "#RRGGBB"; the school's color when left out.
combat_text_color.title: Combat Text Color

death_message.description: Death message when this school kills: "%1$s burned to ashes". %1$s is the victim; the game passes the killer only sometimes, so no other placeholder is allowed.

id.description: Lowercase snake_case id; becomes realmforge:<id>. Must equal the file name.
id.title: Id

kind.description: physical: armor reduces it, it can be dodged; magic: bypasses armor, spell power raises it.
kind.title: Kind

name.description: The school's name, shown in tooltips and on the character sheet.

power.title: Power
